entities.summary: Israfil Ashurly is an Azerbaijani mountaineer. He is a co-founder of Azerbaijan Alpine Club. He was executive secretary of the Ice-Climbing Commission (2010–2017) under the UIAA, president of the youth committee UIAA, president of the Azerbaijan Mountaineering Federation (2010–2016), Member of the Presidium of the Euro-Asian Association of Mountaineering and Climbing, and a judge of the international category in ice climbing, master of sports of the Republic of Azerbaijan.
